organization: Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI) - Odisha power sector study
notes: CDRI report 'Towards Resilient Power Infrastructure in Odisha' (Jan 6, 2026): cyclone-prone Odisha suffered over $1.2 billion in power sector damages from Cyclone Fani (2019). Recommends exposure mapping and hazard prioritization, GIS mapping/drones/outage management, and financial mechanisms including liquidity funds, parametric insurance and CAT bonds; roadmap of near/medium/long-term actions for utilities.
recommended_action: Target Odisha transmission/distribution utilities with HydraShield coastal/wind monitoring and exposure analytics; the report's parametric insurance and CAT bond recommendations open a door with insurers and DFIs active in the state.
